details.purpose: For recording a narrative description and clinical interpretation of the findings observed during the physical examination of external auditory canal.
details.use:
Use to record a narrative description of the overall findings observed during the physical examination of external auditory canal.
This archetype has been specifically designed to be used in the 'Examination findings' SLOT within the CLUSTER.exam_ears archetype, but can also be used within the OBSERVATION.exam and other OBSERVATION or CLUSTER archetypes, where clinically appropriate.
Use to provide a framework in which CLUSTER archetypes can be nested in the 'Examination findings' SLOT to record additional structured physical examination findings - for example, CLUSTER.exam_tympanic_membrane or CLUSTER.exam_middle_ear.
The CLUSTER.exclusion_exam archetype can be nested within the 'Examination not done' SLOT to optionally record explicit details about the examination not being performed.
Use to incorporate the narrative descriptions of clinical findings within existing or legacy clinical systems into an archetyped format, using the 'Clinical Description' data element.
details.misuse:
Not to be used for recording data not related to other parts of the ear such as the Pinna or Middle ear - use the specific archetypes, CLUSTER.exam_pinna and CLUSTER.exam_middle_ear.
Not to be used for recording the clinical history - use specific OBSERVATION and CLUSTER archetypes. For example OBSERVATION.story and CLUSTER.symptom.
Not to be used to record stand-alone clinical observations or measurements or test results - use specific OBSERVATION archetypes. For example OBSERVATION.audiogram_result.

items.items: Findings observed during the physical examination of the external auditory canal.
Identification of the ear under examination.
Statement that no abnormality was detected (NAD) on physical examination.
Record as True if no abnormality was detected on examination. Specific statements about the examination can be included in the 'Clinical Interpretation' data element.
Narrative description of the overall findings observed during the physical examination of the external auditory canal.
Structured details about the physical examination findings.
Digital image, video or diagram representing the physical examination findings.
Single word, phrase or brief description that represents the clinical meaning and significance of the physical examination findings.
Additional narrative about the physical examination findings, not captured in other fields.
Details to explicitly record that this examination was not performed.
Narrative description of the wax findings in the external auditory canal.
Presence of tenderness in the external auditory canal.
Tenderness is noted in the external auditory canal wall.
Tenderness is not noted in the external auditory canal wall.
Presence of any offensive odour originating from the external auditory canal.
An offensive odour is noted as originating from the external auditory canal.
No odour is noted as originating from the external auditory canal.
Presence of a discharge observed in the external auditory canal.
Discharge is observed within the ear canal.
Discharge is not observed within the ear canal.
Type of discharge observed in the external auditory canal or at the tympanic membrane.
The discharge appears to consist mostly of blood.
The discharge appears to consist of both blood and clear, watery fluid.
The discharge appears to consist mostly of a thick, mucoid substance.
The discharge appears to consist of both mucous and pus.
The discharge appears to consist mostly of pus.
The discharge appears to consist mostly of clear, watery fluid.
Amount of discharge observed in the external auditory canal or at the tympanic membrane perforation.
A small amount of discharge is observed in the external auditory canal.
A moderate amount of discharge is observed in the external auditory canal.
A profuse amount of discharge is observed in the external auditory canal.
Narrative description of the discharge observed in the external auditory canal or at the tympanic membrane perforation.
Presence of a foreign body in the external auditory canal.
A foreign body is present in the external auditory canal.
A foreign body is not present in the external auditory canal.
Location of the foreign body within the external auditory canal.
This data element is redundant if a foreign body is absent from the canal.
The foreign body is located in the outer part of the external auditory canal.
The foreign body is located in the deep, inner part of the external auditory canal.
The foreign body is located within the middle ear cavity.
